changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.imports ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, id_financial_period bigint NOT NULL, target varchar(10) NOT NULL, id_card bigint, id_wallet bigint, file_type varchar(15), file_name varchar(255) NOT NULL, starting_on date, ending_on date, ledger_balance numeric(15, 2), ledger_balance_on date, status varchar(10) NOT NULL, error varchar(60), saved_on timestamp, undone_on timestamp, CONSTRAINT imports_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT imports_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT ck_imports_on_target CHECK (target IN ('CARD', 'WALLET')), CONSTRAINT ck_imports_on_target_owner CHECK ( (target = 'CARD' AND id_card IS NOT NULL AND id_wallet IS NULL) OR (target = 'WALLET' AND id_wallet IS NOT NULL AND id_card IS NULL) ), CONSTRAINT ck_imports_on_file_type CHECK (file_type IS NULL OR file_type IN ('CREDIT_CARD', 'BANK_ACCOUNT')), CONSTRAINT ck_imports_on_status CHECK (status IN ('PROCESSING', 'READY', 'FAILED', 'SAVED', 'UNDONE')), CONSTRAINT ck_imports_on_error CHECK ((status = 'FAILED') = (error IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT fk_financial_periods_on_imports FOREIGN KEY (id_financial_period) REFERENCES registration.financial_periods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_cards_on_imports FOREIGN KEY (id_card) REFERENCES registration.cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_wallets_on_imports FOREIGN KEY (id_wallet) REFERENCES registration.wallets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX ix_imports_on_financial_period ON financial.imports (id_financial_period); CREATE INDEX ix_imports_on_card ON financial.imports (id_card); CREATE INDEX ix_imports_on_wallet ON financial.imports (id_wallet); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_imports_on_card_draft ON financial.imports (id_card, id_financial_period) WHERE status IN ('PROCESSING', 'READY') AND id_card IS NOT NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_imports_on_wallet_draft ON financial.imports (id_wallet, id_financial_period) WHERE status IN ('PROCESSING', 'READY') AND id_wallet IS NOT NULL;

import_lines_position_key UNIQUE (id_import, position), CONSTRAINT ck_import_lines_on_value CHECK (value <> 0), CONSTRAINT ck_import_lines_on_installments CHECK ( (installment IS NULL AND installments 'LAUNCH_RECURRING', 'CREATE_RECURRING', 'INVOICE_PAYMENT', 'TRANSFER', 'IGNORE')), CONSTRAINT fk_imports_on_import_lines FOREIGN KEY (id_import) REFERENCES financial.imports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_cost_centers_on_import_lines FOREIGN KEY (id_cost_center) REFERENCES registration.cost_centers (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_classifications_on_import_lines FOREIGN KEY (id_classification) REFERENCES registration.classifications (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_target_wallets_on_import_lines FOREIGN KEY (id_target_wallet) REFERENCES registration.wallets (id) ON financial.transfers (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_target_recurrings_on_import_lines FOREIGN KEY (id_target_recurring) REFERENCES financial.recurring_movements (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_created_movements_on_import_lines FOREIGN KEY (id_created_movement) REFERENCES financial.movements (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_created_purchases_on_import_lines FOREIGN KEY (id_created_purchase) REFERENCES financial.card_purchases (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_created_transfers_on_import_lines FOREIGN KEY (id_created_transfer) REFERENCES financial.transfers (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_created_recurrings_on_import_lines FOREIGN KEY (id_created_recurring) REFERENCES financial.recurring_movements (id) ON DELETE SET NULL ); CREATE INDEX ix_import_lines_on_target_transfer ON financial.import_lines (id_target_transfer); CREATE INDEX ix_import_lines_on_target_recurring ON financial.import_lines (id_target_recurring); CREATE INDEX ix_import_lines_on_created_transfer ON financial.import_lines (id_created_transfer); CREATE INDEX ix_import_lines_on_created_recurring ON financial.import_lines (id_created_recurring); CREATE INDEX ix_import_lines_on_identity ON financial.import_lines (fit_id, value);

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.import_name_memories ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, target varchar(10) NOT NULL, normalized_name varchar(150) NOT NULL, action varchar(20) NOT NULL, id_cost_center bigint, id_classification bigint, id_wallet bigint, id_recurring_movement bigint, CONSTRAINT import_name_memories_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT import_name_memories_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT import_name_memories_name_key UNIQUE (target, normalized_name), CONSTRAINT ck_import_name_memories_on_target CHECK (target IN ('CARD', 'WALLET')), CONSTRAINT ck_import_name_memories_on_action CHECK (action IN ('CREATE', 'LINK', 'LAUNCH_RECURRING', 'CREATE_RECURRING', 'INVOICE_PAYMENT', 'TRANSFER', 'IGNORE')), CONSTRAINT fk_cost_centers_on_import_name_memories FOREIGN KEY (id_cost_center) REFERENCES registration.cost_centers (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_classifications_on_import_name_memories FOREIGN KEY (id_classification) REFERENCES registration.classifications (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_wallets_on_import_name_memories FOREIGN KEY (id_wallet) REFERENCES registration.wallets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_recurring_movements_on_import_name_memories FOREIGN KEY (id_recurring_movement) REFERENCES financial.recurring_movements (id) ON DELETE SET NULL );
